objective_value: <float> Total cost of the truss structure, summing cost density times length times chosen area for every bar.

bar_areas.bar_id: <int> Bar to which this area assignment applies.
bar_areas.area: <float> Cross-sectional area selected for this bar from the discrete candidate set.
bar_areas.area_index: <int> Zero-based position of the selected area within the discrete candidate list.

displacements.dof_id: <int> Degree of freedom at which this displacement occurs.
displacements.load: <int> Loading condition under which this displacement occurs.
displacements.value: <float> Nodal displacement at this degree of freedom under this loading condition.

bar_forces.bar_id: <int> Bar in which this internal force acts.
bar_forces.load: <int> Loading condition under which this force occurs.
bar_forces.force: <float> Internal axial force in this bar under this loading condition (positive is tension, negative is compression).
